metadata.title: Extended illustrative network (40 hubs)
metadata.data_status: Real hub locations and air-route pairs; all link values are synthetic.
metadata.disclaimer: Hub locations come from OurAirports and UN/LOCODE, and air links follow scheduled-route pairs in OpenFlights data. Every time, cost, risk and capacity value is an illustrative assumption fitted to the sample network. No live schedules, permissions, security assessments or official Dubai Humanitarian data are included. Do not use this network to plan real aid movements.
metadata.risk_scale: 0 (lower illustrative exposure) to 10 (higher illustrative exposure); ordinal score, not probability
